item.title: Areas of Special Scientific Interest (ASSI) source files
item.subtitle: Designated & Protected Sites / DAERA, Northern Ireland Environment Agency
item.description: Areas of Special Scientific Interest provide statutory protection under the Nature Conservation and Amenity Lands (NI) Order 1985 for the best examples of NI's flora, fauna, geological or physiographical features. The 394 ASSIs are NI's principal site-based wildlife protection mechanism.
